app.title: qPilot Studio
app.summary: A person loads a qPCR instrument export, with an optional sample sheet and a one-sentence description of the experiment. Rules or a model propose the study design and which curves count as amplified. The engine checks each proposal against the data, and the person accepts, edits or rejects each one with a reason, then confirms the stage. Results stay hidden until both of those stages are confirmed. After that, the person decides each choice that could change a conclusion on a Decision Card and drafts a project for the statistics package. They send it as tables plus a script, then read back what was changed there and answer each change with a reason. The result is a confirmed design, a recorded decision for every conclusion-changing choice, and a bundle ready for the statistics package.

task.text: Turn raw qPCR amplification curves into a group comparison whose design, curve calls and conclusion-changing analysis choices are each confirmed by a person with a reason, then hand it to a statistics package and reconcile what changes there.

data.text: A qPCR run file with raw amplification curves for every well on many plates, plus an optional sample sheet. From these come proposals about each sample's and well's role, per-well amplification calls, per-gene fold changes under every reasonable analysis, and tables of log2 relative quantities per biological unit.
data.item: a proposal about one sample, well or series in the study design, checked against the curves

stage.text: reviewing and deciding a qPCR study's design and analysis choices after the run, before statistics and figures

mechanism.text: A staged inbox in the middle shows one card per proposal. Each card has the engine's check (consistent, contradicted or cannot check), its sources and accept, edit and reject controls, and a well cited on a card can be plotted as its curve. A left-hand strip shows which stage is open, confirmed or blocked. The right-hand pane stays blind until the design and curve stages are confirmed; then it shows the results, the Decision Cards, the drafted project with a per-gene graph and table, sending the project to the statistics package, and the round trip back from it.

field.text: relative quantification of gene expression by qPCR (LinRegPCR curve analysis, geNorm reference genes, Welch's t-test on log2 values) in molecular biology

workflow.name: check proposed annotations stage by stage, then decide the analysis choices that change conclusions

steps.here: Drop in an RDML file (or use the cached demo), an optional .xlsx/.csv sample sheet and one sentence about the experiment, then press Open; opening analyses and proposes nothing

steps.step: have proposals made for each item, checked against the data
steps.here: Propose the design, Propose the comparison and Check the curves fill the inbox of the open stage; each card shows the engine check (consistent, contradicted, cannot check), its cited sources and a level

steps.step: decide keep or drop for each item, with a reason
steps.here: Accept, Reject with a reason, or edit the JSON payload and accept; a reason is required to accept what the engine contradicts; Accept all consistent and Reject all contradicted AI calls first list exactly what they cover

steps.step: confirm the stage before moving on
steps.here: Confirm this stage… shows what it covers, and only Yes, confirm closes it; results stay hidden until the Design and Curves stages are both confirmed

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: Once both blind stages are confirmed, a study summary and fold changes appear, computed under every reasonable analysis, along with how many conclusions the usual spreadsheet routes would change

steps.step: decide each choice that could change the result, with a reason
steps.here: Pick a Decision Card, choose an option and type a reason, then Decide; cards are the choices (control genes, cut-off, empty wells, amplification rule) that can flip a conclusion

steps.step: export the result, then reconcile changes made outside
steps.here: Draft the Prism project, preview the per-gene graph and table, then Send to Prism (tables, script and provenance, or a zip); Read what changed in Prism turns each changed or missing value into a question that needs a reason and shows its consequence

distinctive: blind stages: no conclusion, fold change or card can appear until a person confirms both the design and the curve calls
only choices that can flip a conclusion across every reasonable analysis reach a person, as Decision Cards ranked by how many conclusions they change
AI proposals are never applied: a deterministic check can only refute, and accepting a contradicted proposal needs a reason
the round trip from the statistics package reports each value changed or left out there, with its effect on every gene's conclusion, before the person accepts it
every accept, reject, decision and export is written with who made it and why to a hash-chained record
